import re
import sys

values = {}
assignment = re.compile(r"^\s*(\w+)\s*<-\s*(\w+|\d+)\s*;?\s*$")

for line in sys.stdin:
    match = assignment.match(line)
    if not match:
        continue
    target, source = match.groups()
    values[target] = values[source] if source in values else int(source)

names = "a b c d e f g h i j k l m n o p TMP".split()
print("; ".join(f"{name} ?= {values[name]}" for name in names) + ";")
